## FA-015 / ZEUS-39d3d0633060 revision 1 — Refs #16

### Defect (upstream, agreed in cross-review; root review requested changes)
The Baldrix writeback token bound only the proposal ID and preimage hash — not the reviewed patch hash or the canonical target identity; consume did not serialize read/check/unlink and swallowed unlink errors; rollback did not verify the audited target set or sidecar preimages. Consensus: bind immutable proposal/patch/revision/environment/canonical target ID and preimage/postimage hashes into the application contract.

### Zeus
The unit of application is a Git candidate (`revision`/`base`/`tree`), with reviews bound to the revision, verification to revision + policy hash, promotion intents to candidate hash/image/remote, a CAS deployment pointer and tree checks before and after merge. Two gaps remained:
1. The candidate never named its **target repository**; a reconfigured `HARNESS_GITHUB_REPO` between review and promotion could consume a review granted for another repository (the intent only recorded the remote at promotion time).
2. The **patch** was only implicit in the commit; the runner's re-derived diff was used for the tree check only.

Change: `git.capture()` adds `repository` (GitHub slug or `local`) and `diff_hash` (SHA-256 of the base→revision diff) to the candidate identity (so reviews/verification/intents bind them); `ReleaseRunner._run` re-derives the diff (`Candidate patch mismatch`) and checks the target before any check/canary; `_promote`, `git.merge` and `git.publish` re-check the target (`Candidate target repository changed since review`), merge also re-checks the diff hash. Candidates captured before this change (no fields) remain mergeable. `INV-RELEASE-001` updated; record in `docs/zeus/implementation/candidate-target-binding-001/`.

### Verification
| | Result |
|---|---|
| `test_capture_binds_target_repository_and_patch_hash_and_merge_rechecks_them` (real Git): fields recorded, remote-configured adapter refuses merge/publish, tampered `diff_hash` refused, main untouched, legacy candidate merges | pass |
| `test_runner_refuses_reviewed_candidate_whose_patch_or_target_drifted[patch\|repository]`: doubly reviewed release refused before checks; release stays `reviewed`, no intent/deployment | pass |
| Existing remote-interruption recovery tests now fix the remote **before** capture (mutating it afterwards is exactly the drift now refused) | pass |
| Negative control: revert `git.py`/`deployment.py` to `origin/main` | the 3 new checks fail |
| git workspace + release modules + ticket execution | 47 passed, 31 skipped (PG/integration) |
| Windows full `uv run pytest -q` (Python 3.12.14) / `ruff check` | 920 passed, 305 skipped / clean |
| Linux path | this PR's ubuntu CI matrix |

### Not claimed
Upstream's single-use consume token has no Zeus counterpart (promotion intents are created once under the PG transaction CAS, FA-004); multi-file partial application does not arise with Git commits; rollback remains the `INV-RECOVERY-001` controller path. Issue closure follows the ledger acceptance path (#30) and is a separate step after this PR; the GitHub issue stays OPEN until that acceptance.
